exact_scope: Actual finite trajectories; exact prefix products and exponentiated logarithmic identities; rational-level first crossings and clock maps. Finite tests do not establish natural density.

diagnostics.scope: Logarithmic path and passage inequalities and moving-rank comparisons are numerical diagnostics, not formal certificates.

formal_status: General results are written proofs, self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review or Lean replay.
